<template>
  <q-layout view="hHh lpR fFf">

      <q-page class="material-page">
        <q-tabs
          v-model="activeTab"
          indicator-color="transparent"
          dense
          align="left"
          no-caps
          class="material-tabs"
        >
          <q-tab
            name="materials"

          />

          />
        </q-tabs>

        <q-tab-panels
          v-model="activeTab"
          animated
          class="bg-transparent"
        >
          <q-tab-panel
            name="materials"
            class="material-tab-panel material-tab-panel-materials"
          >
            <materialSearchPanel
              v-model="searchValue"
              :suggestions="suggestions"
              @select-suggestion="handleSuggestionSelect"
              @scan="scanPlaceholder"
            />

            <materialTable
              class="q-mt-md"
              :rows="rows"
              :total-rows="totalRows"
              :page="currentPage"
              @more-info="openDetails"
              @page-change="handlePageChange"
            />
          </q-tab-panel>

          <q-tab-panel
            name="material-classes"
            class="material-tab-panel material-tab-panel-classes"
          >
            <materialClassesView :is-active="activeTab === 'material-classes'" />
          </q-tab-panel>
        </q-tab-panels>

        <materialDetailsDialog
          v-if="details !== null"
          v-model="isDetailsOpen"
          :details="details"
          @save="handleDetailsSave"
        />
      </q-page>
    </q-page-container>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { useProfileStore } from '@/Auth/store/user-auth-store.ts';
import materialClassesView from './material-classes-view.vue';
import materialDetailsDialog from './material-details-dialog.vue';
import materialSearchPanel from './material-search-panel.vue';
import materialTable from './material-table.vue';
import type { MaterialDetailsDto, MaterialRowDto } from '../materialDto/update-material.dto.ts';
import {
  getMaterialDetailsByCode,
  getMaterialsPage,
  getMaterialSuggestions,
  type MaterialSuggestionDto,
} from '../service/api.ts';

const profileStore = useProfileStore();

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    openDetailsOnMount?: boolean
  }>(),
  {
    openDetailsOnMount: false,
  },
);

const activeTab = ref('materials');
const searchValue = ref<string | undefined>(undefined);
const isDetailsOpen = ref(props.openDetailsOnMount);
const rows = ref<MaterialRowDto[]>([]);
const details = ref<MaterialDetailsDto | null>(null);
const suggestions = ref<MaterialSuggestionDto[]>([]);
const selectedMaterialCode = ref<string | undefined>(undefined);
const isApplyingSuggestion = ref(false);
const currentPage = ref(1);
const totalRows = ref(0);
let suggestionsTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

const ROWS_PER_PAGE = 12;

function getPlant(): number {
  const plant = Number(profileStore.userAttributes.plant);
    return Number(plant);
}

async function loadRows(page = currentPage.value): Promise<void> {
  const result = await getMaterialsPage(
    getPlant(),
    page,
    ROWS_PER_PAGE,
    selectedMaterialCode.value,
  );
  rows.value = result.rows;
  totalRows.value = result.total;
  currentPage.value = page;
}

async function loadSuggestions(): Promise<void> {
  suggestions.value = await getMaterialSuggestions(getPlant(), searchValue.value);
}

async function openDetails(materialCode: string): Promise<void> {
  details.value = await getMaterialDetailsByCode(materialCode, getPlant());
  if (details.value !== null) {
    isDetailsOpen.value = true;
  }
}

function scanPlaceholder(): void {
  globalThis.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('materials:scan-clicked'));
}

async function handleSuggestionSelect(materialCode: string): Promise<void> {
  isApplyingSuggestion.value = true;
  selectedMaterialCode.value = materialCode;
  searchValue.value = materialCode;
  currentPage.value = 1;
  clearTimeout(suggestionsTimer);
  suggestions.value = [];
  await loadRows(1);
  suggestions.value = [];
}

function handlePageChange(page: number): void {
  void loadRows(page);
}

function handleDetailsSave(updatedDetails: MaterialDetailsDto): void {
  details.value = updatedDetails;
  rows.value = rows.value.map((row) => {
    if (row.materialCode !== updatedDetails.materialCode) {
      return row;
    }

    return {
      ...row,
      description: updatedDetails.description,
      materialClasses: [...updatedDetails.classes],
      storageLocations: [...updatedDetails.storageLocations],
      type: updatedDetails.type,
    };
  });
}

watch(searchValue, (newValue) => {
  clearTimeout(suggestionsTimer);

  if (isApplyingSuggestion.value) {
    isApplyingSuggestion.value = false;
    suggestions.value = [];
    return;
  }

  if (newValue === undefined || newValue === '') {
    suggestions.value = [];
  } else {
    suggestionsTimer = setTimeout(() => { void loadSuggestions(); }, 300);
  }

  if (selectedMaterialCode.value !== undefined) {
    selectedMaterialCode.value = undefined;
    currentPage.value = 1;
    void loadRows(1);
  }
});

onMounted(async () => {
  await loadRows();

  if (props.openDetailsOnMount && searchValue.value !== undefined) {
    await openDetails(searchValue.value);
  }
});
</script>

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates

  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

  batch: true
  branches:

      - develop

      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/httpd:2.4 AS base

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22.2 AS build

ARG DEBUG_BUILD="false"

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

## DEBUG_BUILD is initialized with a lowercase value
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm install \
    && npm run build:meta-env-bin \
    && DEBUG_BUILD=$(echo ${DEBUG_BUILD} | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') \ 
    && npm run build -- --sourcemap $DEBUG_BUILD

FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/httpd.conf /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf

COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/.htaccess /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/.htaccess

COPY --from=build /app/import-meta-env /app/

COPY --from=build /app/.env.dist /app/.env.dist

COPY --from=build /app/start.sh /app/start.sh

RUN adduser --system httpd --gid 0 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /usr/local/apache2 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /app

USER httpd

CMD ["/bin/sh", "-c", "/app/start.sh"]
